gate.no_worse: on at least 5 of the 6 datasets, the holdout difference (search minus default, oriented so positive is better) has its 90% lower bound above -0.005
gate.honest: on at least 5 of the 6 datasets, the selection fold's score lies within the search arm's own holdout 90% interval
gate.gain_named: the mean difference over the datasets is reported with its range; no claim of a gain unless a dataset's lower bound is above zero
